findings.body: The previous metadata defect remains open. This provider-confirmed selection updates activity records, but the lane retains the initial `chosen` snapshot from review.py:509. The same gap occurs when worker.py:165 switches providers and in both reader paths at story.py:222–231: repo.py:411–419 permits an empty selection, while confirmed settings at repo.py:278–283 and codex.py:384–386 update only activity records. Consequently, board lane entries can show null or obsolete model and effort values for running agents. Refresh the shared entry whenever a provider confirms or changes its selection.
findings.title: Refresh lane metadata when the provider selects its model and effort

Complete it there; this is advice rather than an AGENTS blocker.
